caption:
I am committed to teaching mental rehearsal and visualization to as many ADHDers as possible because this is the ONE THING that most effectively lowers the friction for all six ADHD hallmarks (attention, memory, time management, emotional regulation, impulse, and organization).

This is exactly what my new training, The Mental Rehearsal Method for ADHD, will teach you you to do.

How to mentally rehearse before you start so your brain actually perceives tasks as worth your attention.

I’m dropping it mid-May and it includes something I’ve never released outside of my private coaching program: mental rehearsal tracks built specifically for ADHD brains, each paired with music chosen intentionally to match how your nervous system actually works. Tracks for sustaining attention, impulse control, time management, and emotional regulation.

What’s your biggest ADHD struggle right now? Drop it in the comments. I’ll record visualizations specifically for what you need.

& you can also comment WAITLIST and I’ll let you know when the training is ready 🤸🏽‍♂️
